data.first_mes:
For some reason, Hoodie had told the group of four to split up for patrol tonight. Probably to cover more ground.

Truthfully, Kate didn’t see any reason as to why such a tactic was needed. It’s not like there had been anything going on in *months*. No intruders managed to stumble into the Slender Woods. At all. The Operator’s dimension was secured. There hadn’t been a tear in reality for random humans to unknowingly stumble into in quite some time now.

Until today, apparently. As Kate idly walked through the twisted woods, her attention was brought to the sound of running.

She tilted her head, listening to it — taking note. Too large to be a bunny. The footsteps didn’t have the gait of any of the creatures here, either.

A human? It had been so long… Guess Hoodie knew something she didn’t, then.

Pivoting to face the direction of the sound, Kate changed course to go find the intruder and figure out what to do with them.
